title: 必要な記憶だけ、開く。
audio: none — no narration, TTS, music or audio track
message: One store, two project shelves, three gates: a query returns titles first, the chosen note's neighbours next, and only the chosen note's body last.

data.manifest: assets/manifest.json (SHA-256 a83234ef8ad6f98d84e43f00954b2f069091ce6c166167de644b9d356531a944) pins 7 assets by bytes and SHA-256
data.projection: assets/diagram-data.json is checked call by call against the record; assets/timeline.json fixes the six scenes
data.rule: Every title, ID, order, count and error code drawn comes from the record at load. Short labels and excerpts are checked to be literal parts of the actual titles and returned bodies.

continuous_objects.what: search lens with the query token
values: 保存の前に検索 (0–5s, the related searches before each save)

continuous_objects.what: one SQLite store drawn as one cabinet; header becomes 新しいプロセスで開き直した保存先 after 26.1s
cobalt shelf さくらサイト holding N01 N02 N03
teal shelf つばき資料 holding N04 N05
one book per saved note; key, short spine label and saved ID; colour = project; the same book leaves its slot (dashed place stays) and returns

values: result.step and result.trace of each call

continuous_objects.what: where the returned notes land: title tabs, the bound context pair, the open book, the two scope cards

scenes.tells: Five fictional decisions go into one store, 3 + 2 by project. Each save is preceded by a related search. Replaying N01 returns the same ID; the count stays 5.
scenes.enter: Empty store with five dashed places (truthful to C01: 0 before saving). Lens shows 保存の前に検索.
scenes.motion: For each note in input order: lens pulse + short route to its shelf, then the book drops into its place and a save chip N0x → ID n appears in the tray. A translucent N01 copy drops onto N01 and merges; badge 同じ ID 1.
scenes.exit: Five books on two shelves, header 5件, status 再送は同じ ID 1 ・ 5件のまま.

scenes.tells: The query iOS, scoped to さくらサイト, returns titles only, in returned order N02 then N01. No body.
scenes.enter: Query token becomes iOS; cobalt route to the さくらサイト shelf; gate 1 lights.
scenes.motion: N02 then N01 leave their places and lie flat as title tabs, numbered 1 and 2. From 8.4s N01 gets the warm ring and 呼び出し側が選択 (the calling code chose it).
scenes.exit: Two tabs; status 本文 0件 ・ 題名だけ; gate 1 badge 2件.

scenes.tells: With N01 chosen, the context step returns N01 then N02, depth 1 each side. Still no body; N02 is a neighbour title, not an extra fetched body.
scenes.motion: The tabs swap into returned context order and touch, bound by a bracket. Flags 選んだ1件 on N01 and 前後 on N02. Gate 2 lights.
scenes.exit: Bound pair; status N01の前後1件 ・ 本文 0件.

scenes.tells: Only the chosen N01 body is fetched. The open book quotes a brief exact excerpt of the returned body; it is the saved text, not a generated answer.
scenes.motion: N02 returns to its place. The SAME N01 tab grows and unfolds into an open book: left page N01 · ID 1 · title, right page 「ボタンは44px以上にし、本文をバーで隠さない。」. Gate 3 lights.
scenes.exit: One open book; status 本文 1件 ・ ほかの4件は閉じたまま. Poster frame at 19s.

scenes.tells: The same query iOS in automatic mode, scoped to each project, opens a different note per shelf: N01 for さくらサイト, N04 for つばき資料, one body each, after 題名→前後→本文.
scenes.motion: Routes branch from the same lens to both shelves; N01 folds into a cobalt scope card, N04 leaves the teal shelf as a teal card. Gates pulse 1 → 2 → 3. Before 25.7s both cards return to their places.
scenes.exit: Two scope cards, then the store with all five books; status 同じ「iOS」→ 案件ごとに別の1件.
scenes.scope_note: Project scope separates search ranges; it is not authentication.

scenes.tells: After the database was closed, an actual fresh Bun process reopened the same store: still 5 notes (3 + 2). A NEW query playsinline returns N02 with the same ID 2. The previous process's continuation does not carry over.
scenes.enter: Store with five books; cabinet doors close (25.7–26.05s) and reopen (26.25–26.6s); header becomes 新しいプロセスで開き直した保存先.
scenes.motion: A dashed 前の合図 ticket travels to gate 2 and is stopped with a cross (invalid_continuation); no cursor string is shown. Query token becomes playsinline; new cobalt route; N02 leaves its place and opens: 「playsinline と controls を付ける。」. Gates pulse 1 → 2 → 3.
scenes.exit: From 29.5s the full connected picture holds: store, five places, lens playsinline, blocked ticket, open N02, status 同じ ID 2 ・ 5件のまま, CTA 実際の記録は作例ページで（C01〜C08）.

short_labels.rule: Each short label is a literal part of the actual title; checked at load.

scope.tested_in_the_run: Explicit saveMemory notes, local SQLite FTS5 keyword search, mem_search guided and auto through the unmodified upstream worker functions, one actual fresh Bun process, five recorded guard calls.
scope.not_shown_or_not_tested: Plugin install, hooks, automatic capture or LLM compression, context injection, Chroma or semantic vectors, cloud sync, hosted provider, MCP transport, Japanese semantic search quality.
scope.selection: C03 selection of N01 is in the authored run code, not an AI choice. Auto mode uses deterministic relevance and calls no LLM.
scope.continuation: ms_ continuations live only in the issuing process for 15 minutes; the film never shows a cursor string.
scope.film: Presentation of saved results only. No new inference, model or API call.
